svg.title: Predictive twin architecture
svg.desc: Operator commands in Boston are teed locally to a twin running the same control stack on a MuJoCo plant, so the twin leads the remote Franka Panda in Abu Dhabi by the forward network delay. A reconciler thread compares delayed telemetry against a ring buffer of past twin states, replays the buffered commands forward to the present, and returns a correction to the control loop through a mailbox.
svg.text: same C++ stack, same control law
RunLogger — innovation, measured delays, applied corrections, resync events, phase-aligned error
